title: A fresh turn of phrase
description: Two faces of each letter turn together in a compact dimensional reveal.
useCase: Give a short launch statement a single moment of emphasis.
reducedMotion: The complete phrase is shown immediately without turning or stagger.
limitations: The demo is a single short line. Longer text needs wrapping and locale-specific character segmentation.
look: Pale lavender-grey page with a centred dark violet-grey sans headline, a light hooked-arrow glyph above and a small caption below.
motion: On mount, each letter tips away on the X axis while a copy hinges up from its bottom edge 120 ms behind, staggered 25 ms per letter with ease-out-quart timing.
adapt: Each character renders two `motion.span` faces animating `rotateX` (0 to 90 out, 90 to 0 in) inside a `preserve-3d` wrapper; tune the `index * 0.025` stagger, the 0.32/0.36 s durations and `transformOrigin` values. Replace `text`; changing the `h3` `key` replays it.
